messages:
Grace (Docs): Quick thread — noticed multiple stale SDK snippets and a couple of broken links in the function/tool-calling + structured-output docs. Opening a small PR to consolidate examples and add a migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7901

Ravi (SDK): I can take the TS snippets. Which files?

Grace (Docs): `docs/tool-calling.md`, `docs/structured-output.md`, and `examples/py/func_call.py` + `examples/ts/funcCall.ts`. Also update JSON schema example to use `output` instead of the legacy `tool_output`.

Marta (Eng): I’ll update the schema examples. Proposal: switch examples to `output: { result: string }` and add `additionalProperties: false` so consumer parsers fail on unexpected keys. Sound good?

Noah (PM): Product prefers keeping examples compact. Use `output` as default and add a short backward-compatibility snippet showing the legacy envelope.

Ravi (SDK): Will rename methods in snippets: `callTool` -> `invoke` and types `InvokeResponse` -> `InvokeResult`. I’ll include both legacy and new forms with clear comments.

docs-bot: PR #7901 created by @Grace — link-checker found 1 dead link (old examples site).

Grace (Docs): I’ll patch that link. @Ravi @Marta, can you review today? I want to land this before the next docs deploy.

Ravi (SDK): Reviewing now. Left two minor comments about await placement and import paths.

Marta (Eng): Schema PR drafted and referenced from #7901 (see link in PR body). Added migration blurb: "If you consume `tool_output`, switch to `output` and validate with `additionalProperties: false`."

Noah (PM): After merge, open infra ticket for a redirect from the old examples URL. I’ll take that.

Grace (Docs): Thanks. Plan: merge when both reviews are done, add a CI render test that validates JSON examples against included schemas. Will follow up in PR. :shipit:

Ravi (SDK): ACK — will sign off after addressing my comments.

Marta (Eng): ACK — finishing EOD.

Grace (Docs): Updated PR, fixed dead link, added migration snippet. Target merge tomorrow AM. Ping me if anything blocks.
